subject: English
question_text: Complete the passage using suitable connectors.
stimulus: There lived a poor (a) ----- honest farmer in a village. He lived a very simple life with his wife (b) ----- children. (c) ----- he was honest, he worked hard on his farm from dawn to dusk. One day (d) ----- he was walking in his field, he suddenly saw a purse of gold on the road. He carried it home (e) ----- he could show it to his wife and children.
guide_solution: Use of sentence connectors: (a) but; (b) and; (c) As; (d) while; (e) so that.
